# Bob the AI - MinimalPC Refactoring Script
# Bridges the gap from Windows 95 branding to a professional "MinimalPC" environment.

# 1. Define target directory
TARGET_DIR="MinimalPC_Source/https-github.com-Robertstar2000-MinimalPC-main"

echo "Starting refactor: MinimalPC..."

# Replacing "Windows 95", "Quantum AI OS", and "Quantum" with "MinimalPC"
